messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: AUTOPAGER fired for service=inference-gateway metric=5xx_rate region=us-west1 threshold=4.0% current=9.7% — incident_id PD-TX9z4 (https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-TX9z4)
ops-bot: auto-enrichment: logs from gateway-usw1 show surge in upstream 502s; kvcache evictions spiked around 02:14:21 UTC. sample log: `upstream_resp=502 path=/v1/completions latency_ms=12`
kevin: acked and on it :wave: — I'll triage from the gateway side. anyone running recent canary?
jordan: oncall-night: watching — if this is kv eviction we might see steady 502s after traffic bursts. can you pull eviction metrics?
sara: pulling kvcache evictions now — looks like GC spike on nodes gw-3 and gw-5 starting 02:12:30. eviction_rate per min: gw-3=48, gw-5=52 (baseline ~3)
eli: curious if upstream model pods are healthy — checking model pool (dedicated) health and grpc errors
kevin: running quick checks: `kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=gateway -o wide` shows gw-3 gw-5 restartCount bumped once in last 15m
kevin: also fetching ingress logs with `gcloud logging read 'resource.labels.cluster_name="inference-prod" resource.labels.namespace_name="gateway" severity>=ERROR' --limit 50` and scanning for 502s
jordan: PD shows several customers reporting increased 5xx in us-west API keys — prob customer-impacting, setting status=investigating
ops-bot: estimated scope: 5xx spike affects ~6% of requests in us-west1, error type: 502 with short upstream responses. correlated with batch size bump from a single heavy client at 02:11:45 (client_id=cli-42)
sara: can we rate-limit that heavy client quickly? I can flip a temporary quota on their API key if we want immediate relief
kevin: good idea — please do that while I attempt a soft mitigation: scale gateway pool by +2 to spread load. running: `kubectl -n inference scale deployment gateway --replicas=8`
eli: model pods all healthy, no OOMs on inference nodes. grpc 503s not spiking. looks like gateway local cache eviction is the issue, not model runtime.
jordan: PD escalation: if not acked by a second oncall escalate to eng-lead, but kevin already acked. keep me posted on rollback plan
sara: quota change applied to cli-42 key — 80% reduction in their concurrency. watch for rate shift
ops-bot: telemetry update (02:24:10 UTC): 5xx_rate now 6.1% (was 9.7%). error counts trending down after quota + scale.
kevin: still seeing intermittent 502s but tail latency improving. planning to restart gw-3 and gw-5 gracefully to clear cache fragmentation: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/gateway -n inference --field-selector metadata.name=gw-3` (will stagger)
eli: reminder: before restart, warm caches via a warmup route to model shadows to avoid cold miss flood — run `curl -s "https://internal-warmup/inference?batch=small"` a few times
kevin: doing a staggered restart now (gw-3) — restart issued at 02:29:05 UTC
sara: monitoring customer dashboards — one affected client reported recovery in their region at 02:30 UTC :thumbsup:
jordan: PD notes updated: customer impact reduced, mitigation steps: applied quota to heavy client, scaled gateway pool, restarted affected gateway nodes. next: postmortem and follow-up action items
ops-bot: final telemetry snapshot (02:38:40 UTC): 5xx_rate us-west1=1.2% (back to baseline), global=0.4%. incidentbot auto-close timer armed
kevin: marking incident as mitigated, leaving oncall to own follow-up. I'll spin up a short RFC to add kvcache eviction alerting and a per-client throttle guard so one client can't cause cluster-level evictions
eli: filing follow-up eval to reproduce heavy-client pattern and test warmup path. assigning to eng-runtime.
oncall-night: I'll create the incident postmortem doc and link PD, assigning action items: add a per-client concurrency limit, add eviction-rate alert, and better graceful restart runbook.
jordan: closing loop — thanks everyone for quick moves. final note: PD incident PD-TX9z4 will be annotated with mitigation timeline and notified to customers with impacted API keys list
kevin: :white_check_mark: resolved from oncall side. recommend we run a retrospective tomorrow AM with runtime + gateway owners
sara: adding a short customer update draft to #support-digest after postmortem is posted
ops-bot: system note: incident closed by kevin at 02:42:00 UTC.
